ghNotFound: GitHub CLI (gh) not found. Install it: winget install GitHub.cli
ghNotAuthed: gh is not signed in — run in a terminal: gh auth login
prExists: A pull request for this branch already exists
noCommitsBetween: No commits between the base branch and the current one
pushFirst: Push the branch to the remote first
pushRejected: The remote rejected the push: the branch is behind — pull first
noAccess: No access to the remote repository (check git authentication)
notRepo: The folder is not a git repository
detachedHead: HEAD is detached — switch to a branch
emptyReply: The model returned an empty reply — try again
sameBranch: The current branch is the base branch — create a separate branch
noFailedRuns: No failed GitHub Actions runs found for this branch
